Despite the monetary tightening, India's GDP growth is expected to moderate to 7.2 percent in 2027. Strong domestic demand and an emerging investment cycle are likely to sustain economic activity.

articles.title: Onion farmers seek measures to ensure Rs 3,000 per quintal amid surplus production outlook
articles.desc: Maharashtra onion farmers have asked the Centre to ensure prices of at least Rs 3,000 per quintal by expanding export markets and maintaining a stable export policy, as India is expected to have a sizeable surplus in 2025-26. The growers’ body said better export infrastructure, storage, processing and transparent supply data will be critical to prevent price crashes when market arrivals rise.

articles.title: Govt planning to expand AB-PMJAY packages for public hospitals from 23 to 112: NHA sources
articles.desc: The National Health Authority has proposed expanding health benefit packages reserved for government hospitals under Ayushman Bharat from 23 to 112, adding 89 treatments and procedures. The move aims to improve access to healthcare closer to beneficiaries' homes and channel more reimbursements into strengthening public hospital infrastructure and services.
